visuals.purpose: Two X copies versus one copy at an X-linked locus; defined B/b notation and phenotype rule.
visuals.placement_sentence: Start on the left of the image, where two X symbols appear in each genotype.
visuals.viewing_prompt: Compare heterozygous XX with recessive XX, then the single X in each XY genotype.
visuals.read_order: Complete image is visible; prose gives successive attention steps. No animation or unsupported image control.
visuals.labels_colours_symbols_boundaries: Black X/Y and raised B/b are chromosome/allele symbols, not powers. FEMALES/MALES are the source typicalXX/XY categories. There are no process arrows.
visuals.caption: Two-copy and one-copy expression rules for a simplified X-linked recessive colour-vision model. The image's labels “regular vision” and “colour blind” identify the two categories used in that model.
visuals.alt: Genotype-to-phenotype table for the stated X-linked recessive colour-vision model. XX genotypes XB XB and XB Xb are labelled regular vision; Xb Xb is labelled colour blind. XY genotypes XB Y and Xb Y are labelled regular vision and colour blind respectively.
visuals.constraints_and_exclusion_caveats: Specified common red-green colour-vision model only; no screen diagnostic; labels regular vision/colour blind quoted as image categories. Source table omits carrier label, supplied by adjacent text.

visuals.purpose: Orange/non-orange X-inactivation mosaic and maintained descendant cell lineages.
visuals.placement_sentence: Look at the cat’s orange and black fur.
visuals.viewing_prompt: Compare adjoining orange and black patches; identify white muzzle/paws separately.
visuals.read_order: Complete image is visible; prose gives successive attention steps. No animation or unsupported image control.
visuals.labels_colours_symbols_boundaries: Colour boundaries show visible fur regions, not chromosomes or exact clone boundaries established by measurement. White spotting has separate genetic basis. No arrows or genotype labels.
visuals.caption: Orange and black regions illustrate a mosaic coat. The white regions have a separate genetic basis and are not a third allele outcome produced by X inactivation.
visuals.alt: A cat with orange and black patches across its head and body, and white fur around the muzzle and paws. The photograph shows patches, not chromosomes or the cat's measured genotype.
visuals.constraints_and_exclusion_caveats: Photograph does not establish this individual’s karyotype; rare male exceptions and escape from X inactivation are explained. No blanket only-female claim.

visuals.purpose: Two-locus additive five-category distribution contrasted with three-locus seven-category distribution.
visuals.placement_sentence: Look at panel A first and match a middle-valued AaBb cell to the corresponding genotype in our table.
visuals.viewing_prompt: Read A grid, B horizontal length/vertical relative number, then C seven-class comparison.
visuals.read_order: Complete image is visible; prose gives successive attention steps. No animation or unsupported image control.
visuals.labels_colours_symbols_boundaries: A–C are panel labels; A/a B/b are allele labels. Colours group phenotype classes, not chromosome origins. Bars encode relative frequency; smooth curves are schematic; no causal arrows.
visuals.caption: A simplified additive corn model: two contributing loci give five model categories; three give seven. The smooth curves illustrate a distribution shape, not evidence that a finite genetic model by itself produces every possible length.
visuals.alt: Figure 17.24. Panel A is an AaBb by AaBb square grouping offspring into five additive ear-length categories. Panel B has five bars in the ratio 1, 4, 6, 4, 1 from shortest to longest. Panel C extends the simplified model to three loci and seven categories with relative heights 1, 6, 15, 20, 15, 6, 1. Curves connect the distributions schematically.
visuals.constraints_and_exclusion_caveats: Equal additive effects, ordinary segregation, independent assortment and no environmental variation for genetic class counts. A two-locus model alone has discrete values. Hypothetical10cm+2cm values appear only in authored tables, not claimed as data from figure.
visuals.status: Source-derived candidate, exact selected pixels visually inspected; not a claim of Dean approval
visuals.crop_policy: Rendered directly from supplied PDF; no redraw, relabelling or diagram change. Caption retained. Full page and final crop inspected.
